reason: Free is nice, but I don't have an afternoon to install a local tool, set up a sandbox, record every workflow and then check a list of business rules some AI wrote. I just eyeball the agent's PRs, run what tests we have, and move on.
objection: Recording scenarios and confirming rules sounds like more work than writing tests, and I doubt it works on our old Windows apps without hours of fiddling. Running Meta's models on internal public-sector app data is also something I'd have to clear with security first.
would_change_my_mind: Watching it catch a real regression on one of our own apps in under an hour of setup, fully offline, with no data leaving the box.
